description: Disrupt VPC peering connectivity by replacing route entries with a blackhole ENI, preventing fallthrough to default TGW routes

BlackholeVpcPeeringRoutes.description: Replace VPC peering routes with blackhole ENI for a controlled duration then restore them

parameters.documentArn: arn:aws:ssm:<YOUR REGION>:<YOUR AWS ACCOUNT>:document/<AUTOMATION DOCUMENT NAME>
parameters.documentParameters: {"TargetCidr": "<TARGET VPC CIDR>", "RouteTableIds": ["<ROUTE TABLE ID 1>", "<ROUTE TABLE ID 2>"], "VpcPeeringConnectionId": "<PEERING CONNECTION ID>", "SubnetId": "<SUBNET ID>", "duration": "PT5M", "AutomationAssumeRole": "arn:aws:iam::<YOUR AWS ACCOUNT>:role/<YOUR SSM AUTOMATION ROLE>"}

roleArn: arn:aws:iam::<YOUR AWS ACCOUNT>:role/<YOUR FIS IAM ROLE NAME>
